# `iced_graphics::cache::Cache`

```rust
pub struct Cache<T> { /* private fields */ }
```

A simple cache that stores generated values to avoid recomputation.

Keeps track of the last generated value after clearing.

**Source:** [cache.rs](../../src/iced_graphics/cache.rs.md) (lines 10-14)

## Methods

### `impl<T> Cache<T>`

#### `new`

```rust
pub fn new() -> Self
```

Creates a new empty [`Cache`](struct.Cache.md).

#### `with_group`

```rust
pub fn with_group(group: Group) -> Self
```

Creates a new empty [`Cache`](struct.Cache.md) with the given [`Group`](struct.Group.md).

Caches within the same group may reuse internal rendering storage.

You should generally group caches that are likely to change together.

#### `group`

```rust
pub fn group(&self) -> Group
```

Returns the [`Group`](struct.Group.md) of the [`Cache`](struct.Cache.md).

#### `put`

```rust
pub fn put(&self, value: T)
```

Puts the given value in the [`Cache`](struct.Cache.md).

Notice that, given this is a cache, a mutable reference is not necessary to call this method. You can safely update the cache in rendering code.

#### `state`

```rust
pub fn state(&self) -> &RefCell<State<T>>
```

Returns a reference cell to the internal [`State`](enum.State.md) of the [`Cache`](struct.Cache.md).

#### `clear`

```rust
pub fn clear(&self)
```

Clears the [`Cache`](struct.Cache.md).
